actors.name: Nana Olomu, Governor of the Benin River

summary.text: Nana Olomu, the Itsekiri merchant prince who governed the Benin River trade, stood in the way of the Niger Coast Protectorate. A first attack on his stronghold at Ebrohimi failed; a naval force took it in September 1894. Nana escaped to Lagos and gave himself up, was tried at Old Calabar and exiled to the Gold Coast. He was allowed home in 1906.
